A QUICK START

Up and running
in three steps.

  1. Download the complete setup.

    Use the Windows installer, including when sharing the app with another computer.

  2. Install NexaTik.

    Finish or cancel active tasks and close an existing NexaTik window before installing.

  3. Choose your platform.

    Paste your link, load the video list and select the items you want to save.

Sharing with another laptop?

Share NexaTik-Setup-0.5.2.exe. The installed application file alone does not include its runtime files.
